content_text:
Hi Roger,
I recently watched your documentary ‘Around the World with Ridgway‘ I’m fascinated to know the creative journey in those nine months. Did shooting on a boat every day get repetitive? Were there any technical issues you overcame?
Thanks,
Tom.
